scene_graph.high_level_description:
Frame the piece as a portrait digital vector graphic infographic led by a horizontal bar chart. The chart shows park names, <text 8>, and conservation costs.

Use the middle band for <chart 7>, giving the quantitative display dominant visual weight. Inside it, the quantitative marks, labels, and structural guides remain visually coordinated.

Use <text 2> and <text 3> as the editorial entry point in the upper center, with a clear hierarchy of scale, weight, and spacing. Complete the remaining visual hierarchy with <panel 136> at the lower band, <text 139> at the lower band, <image 4> at the upper right, and <image 5> at the upper right.

Use clean, technical, and editorial against a flat full-canvas field. Use even graphic lighting with subtle shadow effects for local depth and clear layer separation.

style_description.aesthetics: Clean, technical, and editorial. High contrast between text and background. Use of flat surfaces and geometric shapes. Muted background with vibrant chart colors. Modern editorial infographic, technical report style.
style_description.lighting: Flat, even lighting. or gradients. High readability.
style_description.medium: Digital vector graphic, clean lines, solid fills.
